name: p1-hold-right-only
description: ATTACK: degenerate-strategy floor. One key, held, forever: ArrowRight. No jump, no fire, no route reading. This is the least skilled policy that exists, and it is the control case for the whole ladder — if the slice resists this, the ladder's later rungs measure how much skill the slice actually demands above zero. Expected failure point is the +1 ground step at x=39 (groundRuns 32..39 y=2 -> 39..47 y=3 in TRAVERSAL_FIXTURE), which no amount of holding right can climb.
